The update of the next panel column is done\n// first on a separate stream so the next panel factorization / broadcast overlaps\n// with the bulk of the trailing update (look-ahead).\n// OpenMP is used for host side work (matrix assembly for output).\n\nstatic const int NB = 64; k0 < K; k0 += 16) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int q = 0; q < 4; ++q) {\n            const int idx = tid + 256 * q;\n            const int r = idx >> 4, kk = idx & 15;\n            const long kg = k0 + kk;\n            As[kk][r] = (i0 + r < xRows && kg < K) ? X[(i0 + r) * ldx + kg] : 0.0;\n            Bs[kk][r] = (j0 + r < yRows && kg < K) ? Y[(j0 + r) * ldy + kg] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < 16; ++kk) {\n            double a[4], b[4];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r) {\n                a[r] = As[kk][ty + 16 * r];\n                b[r] = Bs[kk][tx + 16 * r];\n            }\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r)\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) acc[r][c] += a[r] * b[c];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate A = B*B^T + n*I directly into the local block-column storage.\n// Local column m holds global block column J = me + P*m, stored full height (npad rows,\n// ld = NB). Padding rows/columns (>= n) form an identity block.\n__global__ void genKernel(const double* __restrict__ B, double* loc, long n, long npad, int P,\n                          int me) {\n    const long J = me + (long)P * blockIdx.y;\n    const long j0 = J * NB;\n    const long i0 = j0 + (long)blockIdx.x * 64;\n    if (i0 >= npad) return;\n    double acc[4][4] = {};\n    tileDot(acc, B, n, n, B, n, n, n, i0, j0);\n    double* C = loc + (long)blockIdx.y * npad * NB;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {\n            const long i = i0 + threadIdx.y + 16 * r;\n            const long j = j0 + threadIdx.x + 16 * c;\n            double v;\n            if (i < n && j < n)\n                v = acc[r][c] + (i == j ? (double)n : 0.0);\n            else\n                v = (i == j) ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n            C[i * NB + (j - j0)] = v;\n        }\n}\n\n// Factor the 64x64 diagonal block at the top of the panel (single block).\n__global__ void diagKernel(double* pan, int* status, long k0) {\n    __shared__ double S[NB][NB + 1];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) S[idx / NB][idx % NB] = pan[idx];\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int j = 0; j < NB; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double v = S[j][j];\n            if (v <= 0.0 || v != v) {\n                if (*status == 0) *status = (int)(k0 + j + 1);\n                S[j][j] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                S[j][j] = sqrt(v);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const double d = S[j][j];\n        for (int r = j + 1 + tid; r < NB; r += blockDim.x) S[r][j] /= d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n            const int r = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n            if (c > j && r >= c) S[r][c] -= S[r][j] * S[c][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int r = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n        pan[idx] = (c <= r) ? S[r][c] : 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Panel solve: rows below the diagonal block, X * L11^T = A21 (one thread per row).\n__global__ void trsmKernel(double* pan, long rows) {\n    __shared__ double S[NB][NB + 1];\n    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x)\n        S[idx / NB][idx % NB] = pan[idx];\n    __syncthreads();\n    const long r = NB + (long)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= rows) return;\n    double* row = pan + r * NB;\n    double x[NB];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int c = 0; c < NB; ++c) x[c] = row[c];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int c = 0; c < NB; ++c) {\n        double s = x[c];\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int t = 0; t < c; ++t) s -= x[t] * S[c][t];\n        x[c] = s / S[c][c];\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int c = 0; c < NB; ++c) row[c] = x[c];\n}\n\n// Trailing update of local block columns m in [mFirst, mFirst+mCount):\n//   C[i][c] -= sum_t pan[i-k0][t] * pan[J*NB+c-k0][t]    for i >= J*NB\n__global__ void updateKernel(const double* __restrict__ pan, double* loc, long npad, long k0,\n                             int P, int me, int mFirst) {\n    const int m = mFirst + blockIdx.y;\n    const long J = me + (long)P * m;\n    const long j0 = J * NB;\n    const long i0 = j0 + (long)blockIdx.x * 64;\n    if (i0 >= npad) return;\n    const long rows = npad - k0;\n    double acc[4][4] = {};\n    tileDot(acc, pan, NB, rows, pan, NB, rows, NB, i0 - k0, j0 - k0);\n    double* C = loc + (long)m * npad * NB;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {\n            const long i = i0 + threadIdx.y + 16 * r;\n            const int cc = threadIdx.x + 16 * c;\n            C[i * NB + cc] -= acc[r][c];\n        }\n}\n\n// Validation: compare L*L^T with B*B^T + n*I for a slab of rows. Max stored as bit\n// patterns of non-negative doubles (monotonic as unsigned integers).\n__global__ void validateKernel(const double* __restrict__ L, const double* __restrict__ B, long n,\n                               long rowBeg, long rowEnd, unsigned long long* maxAbs,\n                               unsigned long long* maxRel) {\n    const long i0 = rowBeg + (long)blockIdx.y * 64;\n    const long j0 = (long)blockIdx.x * 64;\n    double rec[4][4] = {}, org[4][4] = {};\n    tileDot(rec, L, n, n, L, n, n, n, i0, j0);\n    tileDot(org, B, n, n, B, n, n, n, i0, j0);\n    double ea = 0.0, er = 0.0;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {\n            const long i = i0 + threadIdx.y + 16 * r;\n            const long j = j0 + threadIdx.x + 16 * c;\n            if (i < rowEnd && j < n) {\n                const double a = org[r][c] + (i == j ? (double)n : 0.0);\n                const double e = fabs(rec[r][c] - a);\n                ea = fmax(ea, e);\n                er = fmax(er, e / (fabs(a) + 1e-10));\n            }\n        }\n    atomicMax(maxAbs, (unsigned long long)__double_as_longlong(ea));\n    atomicMax(maxRel, (unsigned long long)__double_as_longlong(er));\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host code\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic void printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nstatic double bitsToDouble(unsigned long long b) {\n    double d;\n    memcpy(&d, &b, sizeof d);\n    return d;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank, P;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &P);\n\n    // One GPU per rank (round-robin among ranks on the same node)\n    {\n        MPI_Comm local;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local);\n        int lrank;\n        MPI_Comm_rank(local, &lrank);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&local);\n        int ndev = 0;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&ndev));\n        if (ndev == 0) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices found\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(lrank % ndev));\n    }\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    const long nbk = (long)((n + NB - 1) / NB);\n    const long npad = nbk * NB;\n    const long nl = (long)n;\n    const int nlocal = (rank < nbk) ?  // block width (must be 64, matches kernel tiling)\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); Padding rows/columns (>= n) form an identity block.\n__global__ void genKernel(const double* __restrict__ B, double* loc, long n, long npad, int P,\n                          int me) {\n    const long J = me + (long)P * blockIdx.y;\n    const long j0 = J * NB;\n    const long i0 = j0 + (long)blockIdx.x * 64;\n    if (i0 >= npad) return;\n    double acc[4][4] = {};\n    tileDot(acc, B, n, n, B, n, n, n, i0, j0);\n    double* C = loc + (long)blockIdx.y * npad * NB;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {\n            const long i = i0 + threadIdx.y + 16 * r;\n            const long j = j0 + threadIdx.x + 16 * c;\n            double v;\n            if (i < n && j < n)\n                v = acc[r][c] + (i == j ? (double)n : 0.0);\n            else\n                v = (i == j) ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n            C[i * NB + (j - j0)] = v;\n        }\n}\n\n// Factor the 64x64 diagonal block at the top of the panel (single block).\n__global__ void diagKernel(double* pan, int* status, long k0) {\n    __shared__ double S[NB][NB + 1];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) S[idx / NB][idx % NB] = pan[idx];\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int j = 0; j < NB; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double v = S[j][j];\n            if (v <= 0.0 || v != v) {\n                if (*status == 0) *status = (int)(k0 + j + 1);\n                S[j][j] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                S[j][j] = sqrt(v);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const double d = S[j][j];\n        for (int r = j + 1 + tid; r < NB; r += blockDim.x) S[r][j] /= d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n            const int r = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n            if (c > j && r >= c) S[r][c] -= S[r][j] * S[c][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int r = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n        pan[idx] = (c <= r) ? i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    const long nbk = (long)((n + NB - 1) / NB);\n    const long npad = nbk * NB;\n    const long nl = (long)n;\n    const int nlocal = (rank < nbk) ? In step k the owner of block column k factors the diagonal block and\n// solves the panel on its GPU, then broadcasts the panel. Every rank updates its own\n// trailing block columns on its GPU. The update of the next panel column is done\n// first on a separate stream so the next panel factorization / broadcast overlaps\n// with the bulk of the trailing update (look-ahead).\n// OpenMP is used for host side work (matrix assembly for output).\n\nstatic const int NB = 64;  // block width (must be 64, matches kernel tiling)\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Device code\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Computes a 64x64 tile: acc[i][j] = sum_k X[i0+i][k] * Y[j0+j][k]  (row-major X,Y)\n// Block of 16x16 threads, each thread owns a 4x4 sub-tile (strided by 16).\n__device__ __forceinline__ void tileDot(double acc[4][4], const double* __restrict__ X, long ldx,\n                                        long xRows, const double* __restrict__ Y, long ldy,\n                                        long yRows, long K, long i0, long j0) {\n    __shared__ double As[16][64];\n    __shared__ double Bs[16][64];\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x, ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const int tid = ty * 16 + tx;\n    for (long k0 = 0; k0 < K; k0 += 16) {\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int q = 0; q < 4; ++q) {\n            const int idx = tid + 256 * q;\n            const int r = idx >> 4, kk = idx & 15;\n            const long kg = k0 + kk;\n            As[kk][r] = (i0 + r < xRows && kg < K) ? X[(i0 + r) * ldx + kg] : 0.0;\n            Bs[kk][r] = (j0 + r < yRows && kg < K) ? Padding rows/columns (>= n) form an identity block.\n__global__ void genKernel(const double* __restrict__ B, double* loc, long n, long npad, int P,\n                          int me) {\n    const long J = me + (long)P * blockIdx.y;\n    const long j0 = J * NB;\n    const long i0 = j0 + (long)blockIdx.x * 64;\n    if (i0 >= npad) return;\n    double acc[4][4] = {};\n    tileDot(acc, B, n, n, B, n, n, n, i0, j0);\n    double* C = loc + (long)blockIdx.y * npad * NB;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {\n            const long i = i0 + threadIdx.y + 16 * r;\n            const long j = j0 + threadIdx.x + 16 * c;\n            double v;\n            if (i < n && j < n)\n                v = acc[r][c] + (i == j ? (double)n : 0.0);\n            else\n                v = (i == j) ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n            C[i * NB + (j - j0)] = v;\n        }\n}\n\n// Factor the 64x64 diagonal block at the top of the panel (single block).\n__global__ void diagKernel(double* pan, int* status, long k0) {\n    __shared__ double S[NB][NB + 1];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) S[idx / NB][idx % NB] = pan[idx];\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int j = 0; j < NB; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double v = S[j][j];\n            if (v <= 0.0 || v != v) {\n                if (*status == 0) *status = (int)(k0 + j + 1);\n                S[j][j] = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                S[j][j] = sqrt(v);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const double d = S[j][j];\n        for (int r = j + 1 + tid; r < NB; r += blockDim.x) S[r][j] /= d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n            const int r = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n            if (c > j && r >= c) S[r][c] -= S[r][j] * S[c][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int r = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n        pan[idx] = (c <= r) ? Max stored as bit\n// patterns of non-negative doubles (monotonic as unsigned integers).\n__global__ void validateKernel(const double* __restrict__ L, const double* __restrict__ B, long n,\n                               long rowBeg, long rowEnd, unsigned long long* maxAbs,\n                               unsigned long long* maxRel) {\n    const long i0 = rowBeg + (long)blockIdx.y * 64;\n    const long j0 = (long)blockIdx.x * 64;\n    double rec[4][4] = {}, org[4][4] = {};\n    tileDot(rec, L, n, n, L, n, n, n, i0, j0);\n    tileDot(org, B, n, n, B, n, n, n, i0, j0);\n    double ea = 0.0, er = 0.0;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < 4; ++r)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {\n            const long i = i0 + threadIdx.y + 16 * r;\n            const long j = j0 + threadIdx.x + 16 * c;\n            if (i < rowEnd && j < n) {\n                const double a = org[r][c] + (i == j ? i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    const long nbk = (long)((n + NB - 1) / NB);\n    const long npad = nbk * NB;\n    const long nl = (long)n;\n    const int nlocal = (rank < nbk) ? {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg4VdPfdwavJPTWZWt6MG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I rewrote `cholesky.cpp` as a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program and updated `CMakeLists.txt`. The executable is still `cholesky`, and I created no new files. It builds cleanly. With `-v` it passes for np = 1, 2 and 4 at n = 1, 50, 64, 65, 700 and 3000.\n\n**How it works**\n- **MPI:** the matrix is split into 64-wide block columns dealt out cyclically across ranks, one GPU per rank. In each step the owning rank factors its diagonal block and solves the panel below it. It then broadcasts the panel, and every rank updates its own remaining columns.\n- **CUDA:** I wrote the kernels by hand, so there is no cuBLAS or cuSOLVER dependency. They cover matrix generation (`B·Bᵀ + n·I`), the diagonal-block factorization, the panel solve and the trailing update. Validation also runs on the GPU.\n- **Overlap:** each rank updates the next panel column first, on its own stream. The next factorization and broadcast therefore overlap with the rest of the trailing update.\n- **OpenMP:** it is used only for assembling the final matrix on rank 0, which happens only with `-r` or `-v`.\n- **Semantics:** the random matrix is generated the same way as the original, using the same `rand_r` seed. The output format and the \"not positive definite\" error message are unchanged, and only rank 0 prints. The timed region covers just the factorization, and the validation tolerance is unchanged.\n- **Build:** CMake now compiles the source as CUDA, links MPI, OpenMP and the CUDA runtime, and defaults to native GPU architectures.\n\n**Performance (4 × RTX 3090)**\n\n| n | Ranks | Time | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 12000 | 1 | 984 ms | 585 |\n| 12000 | 4 | 805 ms | 716 |\n\nAt n = 12000 the 4-rank run is only about 1.2× faster than the 1-rank run, and at n ≤ 3000 more ranks were slower. I tested these on the 4 GPUs of this machine. For small n, broadcast cost and the sequential panel factorization dominate. The 3090's weak FP64 throughput also limits the update kernels. I didn't test larger sizes, where scaling should improve.\n\n**Limitations**\n- Each rank holds the full random matrix `B` on its host and GPU. Rank 0 also holds the whole `n × n` result when `-r` or `-v` is used.\n- Each rank's local storage is full height. That wastes about half the memory, but it kept the indexing simple.\n- The timing line prints \"inf GFLOPS\" when the run takes under 1 ms, as the original would."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":449,"cache_read_input_tokens":40407,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":449},"output_tokens":792,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"2c4fe19e-8461-4293-884e-5e7b9e879ddf","uuid":"017e7edf-bcbd-4c26-a338-840be1c5bcfe","timestamp":"2026-10-15T18:27:12.834Z","request_id":"req_011Cg4VdPMnJwx7jdHqHkGDM"}
